# Rockstar_ibot

A proactive general agent that manages your body, mind, and money, follows through in the real world, and coordinates verified essentials support through human-approved, vendor-direct provision rather than recipient cash payouts.

## The problem

A person's life is split across calendars, applications, health routines, bank accounts, investments, and dashboards. Advice is abundant; dependable execution and verification are scarce.

## The product

Rockstar_ibot coordinates a Daily Organ, a Physical / Mental Organ, and a Financial Organ. It uses specialist agents for semantic work and deterministic code for arithmetic, state, permissions, and receipts.

## Mission

End suffering for humans and, ultimately, all living beings by making dependable care, agency, and verified access to essentials continuously available. Rockstar_ibot grows from managing one human life across physical health, mental wellbeing, finances, work, and schedules into a general manager and essentials-distribution network for every living being.

## Current boundary

Begin with Kai's local runtime and owner-only Hub. No receipt-backed Rockstar_ibot revenue claim has been verified for Kai. A future paid monthly option for an always-on hosted Rockstar_ibot; pricing and billing are not configured.

## Trust

Least privilege, owner-separated accounts, no invented success, no guaranteed financial returns, and explicit provenance for every claim.
